caption: The drawing depicts a circular medallion or carved relief at the center of a plain, beige background. Within the circle, there is an animal resembling a goat or an antelope, standing on four legs and facing left. The animal features detailed, repeated patterns on its body suggesting texture or fur. Surrounding the animal are several botanical elements, including two large stylized flowers and multiple leaves, both above and below the animal. The circular perimeter of the medallion has a decorative, rope-like border. The drawing is executed in muted tones of brown, beige, and gray, giving a carved wood or stone appearance. To the right and slightly below the medallion, the signature “Albert Levone” is inscribed in small, neat lettering. The rest of the background is unadorned and light in color, with no additional objects present.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
